thread:
vivian: raised a concern from a partner: they want deterministic, auditable downgrade paths for on-prem bundles. currently we only support forward-only applies; need a safe rollback contract.
omar: agreed. rolling back a model/image in air-gapped infra is risky. need to ensure we can prove the previous artifact was intact & signed before we switch back.
kevin: proposal: introduce a signed "rollback voucher" emitted when a manifest is activated. voucher contains origin_manifest_seq, active_hash, preserved_checksums, activation_timestamp, and an HSM signature. operator stores voucher alongside active artifact.
tara: voucher helps but we need a policy to govern automatic vs manual rollback. I suggest three modes: auto (allowed within T minutes), assisted (operator downloads rollback patch but requires admin confirm), manual (always requires human).
vivian: config keys: `rollback_mode`, `rollback_window_minutes`, `preserve_snapshots` (bool), `max_rollback_size_bytes`. default rollback_window = 60.
omar: for large models we should avoid full copy duplication. store copy-on-write snapshots or keep metadata that allows reconstructing previous state by applying inverse-deltas. that means we must store per-file change-sets (reverse patchlets).
kevin: technical detail: when creating voucher, hub should also produce `inverse_delta` if preservation is requested. inverse_delta is signed and chunked same as forward flow. operator stores it under `vouchers/<manifest_seq>/inverse/`.
tara: operator state machine additions: `active`, `rollback_pending`, `rolling_back`, `rollback_failed`, `rolled_back`. include `rollback_requester` and `rollback_reason` in state for audit.
vivian: security: rollbacks are a big attack surface. vouchers must be signed by a key tagged `rollback-issuer`. rotate the key carefully; allow voucher acceptance for vouchers signed by any valid `rollback-issuer` in the issuer-history window.
omar: also require an optional `operator_approval` signature for assisted/manual modes. meaning two-party approval. operator signs its own attestation that pre-rollback checks passed.
kevin: sample voucher proto (JSON):
```json
{
  "voucher_id": "voucher-2026-03-30-01",
  "origin_manifest_seq": 2441,
  "origin_hash": "sha256:abc...",
  "preserved_checksums": ["sha256:...", "sha256:..."],
  "issued_by": "hub-issuer-v3",
  "issued_at": "2026-03-30T01:12:00Z",
  "mode": "assisted",
  "signature": "sig-v1:..."
}
```
tara: UX: Console should show available vouchers per-site with age, size estimate, and a one-click "inspect voucher" that downloads the inverse-delta and runs a dry-run rollback check.
vivian: we need guardrails to avoid rollback loops or flip-flop. proposal: once a site rolls back to seq X, block re-apply of the rolled-forward manifest for N minutes unless explicit override with reason. add metric `rollback_oscillation_count`.
omar: testing: e2e scenarios: 1) small hotfix rollback under low bandwidth; 2) rollback where inverse-delta is missing -> operator must refuse and require full rebootstrap; 3) assisted rollback requiring operator approval; 4) signer rotation during voucher issuance.
kevin: add alerts: `voucher_missing_inverse` (WARN), `rollback_started` (INFO), `rollback_failed` (page if >3 sites fail in 15m).
tara: storage/GC: vouchers are sensitive and take space. keep them for `voucher_retention_days` default 30, configurable per-customer. GC must emit audit events and tombstone voucher meta but not delete operator local snapshots until confirm.
vivian: runbook stub: to perform emergency rollback: 1) validate voucher signature and operator attestation; 2) dry-run inverse-delta apply; 3) escalate approval if dry-run shows data drift; 4) apply rollback with rate-limit to preserve network; 5) monitor telemetry for regressions.
omar: ownership: kevin will draft RFC for voucher format and inverse-delta plumbing. tara will prototype operator state changes and console surfaces. vivian will write security appendix (key handling, audit). ops-bot: RFC-draft created: rfc/rollback-voucher at 2026-03-30T08:03Z :white_check_mark:
kevin: thanks all — will ping when RFC ready for review.
